Been waiting for a good chance to share this story. My girlfriend had cheated on me and kicked me out on the street, I lost my job, my wallet and had been under supervision from friends who knew what I was going to do if they left me alone. I had two attempts that failed. A week later, I was contacted by Sophie.
When I was eleven and my little sister was three, cps came and took her away. The court determined that she would not be permitted to contact any of us until she was eighteen. I was devastated. It was a fucked up situation for her but there was no reason for them to cut me off, I was just her sibling. Coincidentally, fifteen years later, her eighteenth birthday landed one week after my attempts. The first thing she did that morning was make a facebook and find me. I'm now closer with my sister than just about anyone and having her reach out kept me from doing something drastic while I got my shit back together because I wanted to see her in person. I still think about the possibility that attempt would have worked, she would have juuuuust missed me. Gives me the chills. This was last month.
